Sandbox_Injectors.GLOBAL_EFFECT_POLLING_: Rate at which player effects are polled. Debug feature.
Sandbox_Injectors.GLOBAL_OVERDOSE_DECAY_: Amount at which character overdose value decreases.
Sandbox_Injectors.GLOBAL_OVERDOSE_RATE_t: Rate at which character overdose value decreases.
Sandbox_Injectors.GLOBAL_PAINKILLERS_OVE: Amount of overdose added per consumed vanilla painkiller.
Sandbox_Injectors.GLOBAL_OVERDOSE_DEATH_: Whether to force character death when overdose reaches 100%.

Sandbox_Injectors.GLOBAL_INJECTOR_EQUIP_: How much time it takes to equip an injector.
Sandbox_Injectors.GLOBAL_LOGGER_OFFSET_t: Timezone offset applied to log timestamps in hours.
